headline: Settings UX — reconfigure, show, reset paths for config-aware skills

items.prompt_template: Small UX upgrade — for skills with first-run setup questions (currently just stalled-projects, more coming), you can now change your answers anytime. Say 'change my stall settings' or 'reconfigure stalled-projects' to walk the questions again with your current answers pre-filled. Say 'show my stall settings' to just see what's set. Say 'reset stall settings' to start over from defaults. Future skills with setup questions will all support this same pattern.
